description: (3)工学的基盤(Vs=700m/s相当層)における長周期地震動波形_23_愛知県(昭和南海地震) [earthquakes] is a dataset listed in G-spatial Information Center (G空間情報センター), Japan, an open data portal, published or maintained by 内閣府　「南海トラフの巨大地震モデル検討会」及び「首都直下地震モデル検討会」の両検討会. 「南海トラフの巨大地震モデル検討会」及び「首都直下地震モデル検討会」の両検討会において検討を行なった南海トラフ沿いの巨大地震による長周期地震動に関するデータです。 工学的基盤における速度波形 対象とする地震 宝永地震 安政東海地震 安政南海地震 昭和東南海地震 昭和南海地震 最大クラス... Coverage: Japan. The portal files it under the publisher 内閣府　「南海トラフの巨大地震モデル検討会」及び「首都直下地震モデル検討会」の両検討会. Its tags are 南海トラフ. It offers 307 resource(s) in csv, pdf, zip. The portal shows 2024-10-05 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is the data owner's own terms of use (see the dataset page). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-gsi-portal.
